additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0469322-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R6 170002189] Meter Value Interval CRM:03289000056
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Mr. Bartels,
I am reaching out as Sicharge D Expert in regards of ticket
ID0469322.
As per your previous conversation with my colleague, I understand that you want to set the MeterValueSampleInterval key from your OCPP Backend. As mentioned by my colleague, the Interval to receive the MeterValues from the charger during charging
can only be set
from the OCPP Backend
, in your case Chargecloud. There are two ways to set the OCPP key:
The Backend has a section where you can modify the values of all keys. I understand this option is not available in Chargecloud.
You can set the MeterValueSampleInterval via "ChangeConfiguration.req". Here is an example of ChangeConfiguration.req:
The value has to be an integer and it is expressed in seconds.
From charger point of view, you should see the following:
OCPP: Received command: ChangeConfiguration (0487155a-9044-4ea5-9aa9-e15792ef85c0) - {"key":"MeterValueSampleInterval","value":"45"}
OCPP: Send result: ChangeConfiguration (0487155a-9044-4ea5-9aa9-e15792ef85c0) - {"status":"Accepted"}
You can verify the correct setting of the parameter from the Backend, by sending a "GetConfiguration.req" to the charger.
Please let me know if further support is required to set the MeterValueSampleInterval.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon.
With kind regards,
